# Fazal Ali

> Dr. Fazal Ibrahim Ali — writer, scholar, and founder of Omeros AI, a Caribbean initiative in artificial intelligence based in Trinidad & Tobago.

Fazal Ali is a Cambridge Commonwealth Scholar and former Provost of the University of Trinidad and Tobago. Omeros AI is his initiative to stimulate deliberation about AI in the West Indies, support open-source AI adoption and AI security, convene global frontier labs in the Caribbean, drive industrial digitalisation and data infrastructure, address algorithmic and epistemic justice, and position the Caribbean as a strategic AI hub by 2030.

- [Journal](/writing): Long-form essays on AI, education, ecology, and inequality.

- [Palimpsest](/palimpsest): Layered writings on memory, language, and the colonial archive.
- [Podcast](/podcast): Conversations on critical theory in AI.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Images from the practice.
